threads.body: These assertions make the tests brittle across `openai` SDK versions: `prompt_tokens_details` may not be a plain `dict` even if `PromptTokensDetails` can't be imported from this path (e.g., type moved/renamed), and the import check is not a reliable proxy for runtime type. Consider relaxing this to capability-based checks (e.g., accepts `Mapping` or any object/dict from which `cached_tokens` can be read), or remove the type assertion entirely since the tests already validate behavior via the exported span attributes.
